summary: The released ATE evaluator computes mean aligned distance rather than RMSE; an explicit full-rank witness reverses rankings. Persistent twelve-scalar attributes contradict the core five-scalar storage account. Historical run consequences remain unresolved. Local comparative and aggregate errors are Minor.

problems.title: Released tracking metric is not ATE RMSE
problems.claim: Central tracking evaluations use root mean square aligned position error.
assumptions: Rigid position alignment with correspondences; valid full-rank eight-position trajectories
Default Replica config enables final evaluation; historical table binding unknown
problems.check: Parent-written SVD alignment on cube vertices g=(x,y,z) with errors .01*y*z*(1+x)*e1 and .012*y*z*e1; both centered cross-covariances equal8I. Also normalize initial poses.
problems.result: Mean distances1cm and1.2cm rank A first, while true RMSE sqrt(2)cm and1.2cm rank B first. evaluate_ate returns trans_error.mean().
problems.counterevidence: Current release not certified historical experiment version; raw trajectories and logs absent. Depth-L1 published metric is not invalidated by ancillary depth-RMSE naming defect.
problems.impact: Wrong statistic in active central tracking evaluator; possible ordering reversal demonstrated without claiming any particular published score changed.
problems.correction: Return sqrt(mean(trans_error**2)) and regenerate metrics from original aligned run inputs.
problems.repair_verification: Correct formula and ranking witness independently computed; no author-code patch or experiment executed.

problems.title: Persistent storage exceeds claimed five-scalar representation
problems.claim: View tying removes location and rotation storage and retains five Gaussian scalars, saving64.3% against14.
assumptions: Attribute payload only, excluding images, optimizer buffers, camera state and indices
Current source identity distinguished from historical experiment implementation
problems.check: Trace initialization, addition, CUDA concatenation, updates, CPU offloading and whole-dictionary serialization of means3D3+color3+rotation4+opacity1+scale1.
problems.result: Twelve persistent scalars;48N float32 attribute bytes versus20N for five. Reduction against14 is1/7, not9/14.
problems.counterevidence: Five optimized attributes and9/14 abstract arithmetic are correct; zero learning rates do not remove arrays. CPU offloading and head-pose center update are real. No total-memory or scalability failure is inferred.
problems.impact: Demonstrated mismatch in central storage mechanism of available implementation; historical peak-memory effect Needs Evidence.
problems.correction: Implement reconstruction without persistent redundant arrays with full metadata accounting, or report twelve retained attributes and distinguish optimized/resident/peak state.
problems.repair_verification: Static persistence and arithmetic verified; no runtime memory profiling or code modification.

problems.title: ScanNet superlative and two aggregate values are inconsistent
problems.claim: Ours has best average ScanNet tracking; displayed averages summarize corresponding scene values.
problems.location: PDF p7 prose; Tables5/13 pp8/18; Table15 p19; Table18 p21; repeated Tables6/2
assumptions: Simple scene means are the natural displayed aggregation; no alternative weighting disclosed
problems.check: Recompute six-scene Ours/NICE means and LoopSplat ScanNet++ ATE / Point-SLAM Replica PSNR.
problems.result: Ours11.3333 vs unstarred NICE10.7333. LoopSplat mean2.01 not2.05; Point-SLAM mean35.045 not35.17, beyond input rounding uncertainty.
problems.counterevidence: Restricting ScanNet claim to displayed GS methods without marked priors resolves it. Other two corrections do not reverse Ours ranking. Undisclosed weighting could explain means but requires evidence.
problems.impact: Local comparative overstatement and reporting discrepancies; no global method failure established.
problems.correction: Qualify comparison class; correct aggregates or document exact weighting and run inputs.
problems.repair_verification: Exact rational arithmetic and source table pixels checked; raw runs unavailable.

limitations: No author-code execution, benchmark replication, raw-trajectory replay, memory profiling or video analysis.
Available public release is not certified conference-time experiment identity.
External baseline implementations, later revisions and raw run inputs not checked.

unresolved_claims.reason: No original trajectories, logs or code-to-table bindings.
KITTI selected frame ranges and spatial extents absent; storage/residency/peak accounting incomplete.
Corruption distribution and amplitude not specified.
